Requirements summary / priorities (verbatim from security/legal):

 - BYOK + HSM-backed KMS; customer audit logs retained for minimum 7 years; immutable retention for certain case artifacts.
 - Fine-grained access controls + SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning.
 - Query latency SLO: P95 end-to-end <= 250ms for rerank on typical queries; throughput must support bursts of 200 qps for tranche review windows.
 - Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (embedding + rerank) <= $0.015 for steady-state at scale; willing to pay uplift for guaranteed latency under dedicated capacity.
 - Indexing expectations: 5–8M docs initially, expect 2–3x growth year 1. Need efficient cold-store and warm-cache strategy to control token/compute costs.

POC scope and success criteria:
 - Ingest 1M docs (sanitized subset) and demonstrate 95%+ precision on labeled retrieval testset (internal eval set).
 - Validate reranking chain: sparse retrieval -> embeddings top-200 -> dense rerank top-5 under 250ms P95.
 - Show KMS handshake and audit log delivery to their SIEM (Splunk) in test VPC.
 - Provide quantitative cost model: cost/query at 1M qpm/year equivalent and cost reduction levers (quantization, caching, batching).
